applies_why: This judge text grades a link collision over Isaiah 7:14 by saying the defender's CR2 G answers the rows but leaves the sign's sense open.
quote: D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- [CR2] G answers the 'almah/bethulah and near-fulfillment rows, leaving the sign's sense open.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse — I weighed (1) requiring a chain-vs-chain footing assessment before an underdetermined verdict against (2) allowing underdetermined because a cited verse's sense remains open.
why: The judge's stated reason is that Isaiah 7:14's sign sense remains open, so it resolves the link by verse-level openness rather than by weighing chain against chain by footing as K-C requires.
